razom.slovak: Razom sa zotmelo a začalo pršať.
razom.english: All at once it got dark and started to rain.

razom.slovak: Všetci sa razom postavili a začali tlieskať.
razom.english: Everyone stood up at once and started clapping.
I can't do everything at once.

razom.slovak: Deti razom stíchli, keď vošla učiteľka.
razom.english: The children fell silent at once when the teacher came in.

medzinarodne.english: He is an internationally recognised scientist.

medzinarodne.slovak: Firma pôsobí medzinárodne, má pobočky v piatich krajinách.
medzinarodne.english: The company operates internationally and has branches in five countries.

medzinarodne.slovak: Bryndzové halušky sa stali medzinárodne známym jedlom.
medzinarodne.english: Bryndzové halušky have become an internationally known dish.

medzinarodne.slovak: Náš festival sa časom preslávil aj medzinárodne.
medzinarodne.english: Over time our festival became famous internationally too.

zdola.slovak: Zdola zo dvora bolo počuť hlasy detí.
zdola.english: Children's voices could be heard from the courtyard below.

zdola.slovak: Zdola sa ten kopec nezdá taký vysoký.
zdola.english: From below, that hill doesn't seem so high.
Hold the suitcase from underneath, it's heavy.
We painted the walls from the bottom up.

zurivo.english: The wind blew furiously all night.

zurivo.slovak: Zúrivo hľadal kľúče po celom byte.
zurivo.english: He searched furiously for his keys all over the flat.
The dog barked furiously at the postman.

zurivo.slovak: Fanúšikovia zúrivo protestovali proti rozhodnutiu rozhodcu.
zurivo.english: The fans protested furiously against the referee's decision.

napadne.slovak: Bol nápadne oblečený, všetci sa za ním otáčali.
napadne.english: He was conspicuously dressed, everyone turned to look at him.

napadne.slovak: Tie dve sestry sú si nápadne podobné.
napadne.english: The two sisters are strikingly similar.
He was noticeably quiet at the party.
Prices in the shop have gone up noticeably.

zavcasu.slovak: Ráno sme vstali zavčasu, aby sme stihli vlak.
zavcasu.english: We got up early in the morning to catch the train.

zavcasu.slovak: Lístky si kúpte zavčasu, rýchlo sa minú.
zavcasu.english: Buy your tickets early, they sell out fast.

zavcasu.slovak: Prišli sme zavčasu, obchod bol ešte zatvorený.
zavcasu.english: We came early, the shop was still closed.

primarne.slovak: Aplikácia je primárne určená pre študentov.
primarne.english: The app is primarily intended for students.

primarne.slovak: Primárne sa zameriavame na malé firmy.
primarne.english: We focus primarily on small companies.

primarne.slovak: Peniaze použijeme primárne na opravu strechy.
primarne.english: We'll use the money primarily to repair the roof.

primarne.slovak: Tento liek sa primárne používa pri bolestiach hlavy.
primarne.english: This medicine is mainly used for headaches.

radostne.slovak: Deti radostne vybehli von na sneh.
radostne.english: The children ran out joyfully into the snow.

radostne.slovak: Pes nás pri bráne radostne privítal.
radostne.english: The dog greeted us joyfully at the gate.

radostne.slovak: Radostne nám oznámila, že čaká dieťa.
radostne.english: She joyfully told us that she was expecting a baby.

zaujimavo.slovak: Lektor rozprával o histórii veľmi zaujímavo.
zaujimavo.english: The lecturer talked about history in a very interesting way.

zaujimavo.slovak: Znie to zaujímavo, povedz mi viac.
zaujimavo.english: That sounds interesting, tell me more.

zaujimavo.slovak: Kniha je napísaná zaujímavo a čítavo.
zaujimavo.english: The book is written in an interesting and readable way.
It was interesting at work today.

nahlivo.slovak: Náhlivo sa obliekol a utekal na autobus.
nahlivo.english: He hastily got dressed and ran for the bus.

nahlivo.slovak: Večeru zjedla náhlivo, lebo sa ponáhľala do divadla.
nahlivo.english: She ate dinner hastily because she was in a hurry to get to the theatre.
He said a hasty goodbye and left.
They made the decision too hastily.

striktne.english: The doctor strictly forbade me sweets.

striktne.slovak: Na stavbe striktne dodržiavajú bezpečnostné predpisy.
striktne.english: On the building site they strictly follow safety regulations.

striktne.slovak: V knižnici je striktne zakázané jesť.
striktne.english: Eating is strictly forbidden in the library.

striktne.slovak: Recept dodržiavam striktne, gram po grame.
striktne.english: I follow the recipe strictly, gram by gram.

urychlene.english: This situation needs to be dealt with urgently.

urychlene.slovak: Sanitka zraneného urýchlene previezla do nemocnice.
urychlene.english: The ambulance rushed the injured man to hospital.

urychlene.slovak: Musíme urýchlene opraviť strechu, kým príde zima.
urychlene.english: We must repair the roof quickly, before winter comes.

urychlene.slovak: Ak nájdete chybu, urýchlene nás kontaktujte.
urychlene.english: If you find a mistake, contact us promptly.

vitazne.slovak: Hráči víťazne zdvihli trofej nad hlavy.
vitazne.english: The players triumphantly raised the trophy above their heads.

vitazne.slovak: Víťazne vošiel do kuchyne s veľkou rybou v ruke.
vitazne.english: He walked triumphantly into the kitchen with a big fish in his hand.

vitazne.slovak: Víťazne sa usmiala a ukázala nám vysvedčenie.
vitazne.english: She smiled triumphantly and showed us her school report.
Our team finished the season with a win.

priatelsky-adv.slovak: Predavač sa na nás priateľsky usmial.
priatelsky-adv.english: The shop assistant smiled at us in a friendly way.

priatelsky-adv.slovak: Rozišli sme sa priateľsky, bez hádok.
priatelsky-adv.english: We parted on friendly terms, without arguments.

priatelsky-adv.slovak: Susedia sa k nám správali veľmi priateľsky.
priatelsky-adv.english: The neighbours were very friendly to us.
The dog wagged its tail in a friendly way.

nekompromisne.slovak: Rozhodca nekompromisne vylúčil hráča z hry.
nekompromisne.english: The referee uncompromisingly sent the player off.

nekompromisne.slovak: Vedenie nekompromisne trvá na dodržaní termínu.
nekompromisne.english: The management insists uncompromisingly on meeting the deadline.

nekompromisne.slovak: Polícia v obci nekompromisne pokutuje rýchlu jazdu.
nekompromisne.english: The police in the village fine speeding without exception.
He flatly rejected all their proposals.

typicky-adv.slovak: Typicky slovenským jedlom sú bryndzové halušky.
typicky-adv.english: A typically Slovak dish is bryndzové halušky.

typicky-adv.slovak: Ranná dopravná špička je typicky medzi siedmou a ôsmou.
typicky-adv.english: The morning rush hour is typically between seven and eight.
This is typically how teenagers behave.

typicky-adv.slovak: V nedeľu sa u nás typicky varí polievka a rezne.
typicky-adv.english: On Sundays we typically cook soup and schnitzels.

smelo.slovak: Smelo sa prihlásil do speváckej súťaže.
smelo.english: He boldly signed up for the singing contest.

smelo.slovak: Pýtajte sa smelo, na to sme tu.
smelo.english: Don't hesitate to ask, that's what we're here for.

smelo.slovak: Ak sa vám to páči, smelo si vezmite.
smelo.english: If you like it, feel free to help yourself.
He stepped boldly into the darkness.

zvedavo.english: The cat curiously sniffed the new box.

zvedavo.slovak: Deti zvedavo nakúkali do okna obchodu.
zvedavo.english: The children peered curiously into the shop window.

zvedavo.slovak: Zvedavo sa ma pýtal, kde som bol.
zvedavo.english: He asked me curiously where I had been.
The neighbour was watching curiously from the window.

umelecky-adv.english: The exhibition is artistically very valuable.

umelecky-adv.slovak: Film je technicky dobrý, ale umelecky slabý.
umelecky-adv.english: The film is technically good but artistically weak.
The photographs have been edited artistically.

umelecky-adv.slovak: Dcéra je umelecky nadaná, krásne kreslí.
umelecky-adv.english: My daughter is artistically gifted, she draws beautifully.

podvedome.english: I subconsciously reached for my phone.
People subconsciously imitate other people's gestures.

podvedome.slovak: Podvedome som vedel, že niečo nie je v poriadku.
podvedome.english: Subconsciously I knew that something wasn't right.

podvedome.slovak: Podvedome si vyberáme ľudí, ktorí sú nám podobní.
podvedome.english: We subconsciously choose people who are similar to us.

statocne.english: The firefighters bravely fought the fire.

statocne.slovak: Chorobu znášala statočne a nesťažovala sa.
statocne.english: She bore her illness bravely and didn't complain.

statocne.slovak: Statočne povedal pravdu, hoci sa bál.
statocne.english: He bravely told the truth, although he was scared.
The little patient bravely put up with the injection.

hravo.english: The kitten playfully chased a ball of wool.

hravo.slovak: Učiteľka vysvetľuje gramatiku hravo, cez hry a piesne.
hravo.english: The teacher explains grammar playfully, through games and songs.
He passed the test with ease.

hravo.slovak: Šteniatko ma hravo chytilo zubami za rukáv.
hravo.english: The puppy playfully grabbed my sleeve with its teeth.

naliehavo.slovak: Lekár ho naliehavo žiadal, aby prestal fajčiť.
naliehavo.english: The doctor urgently asked him to stop smoking.
I urgently need to talk to you.

naliehavo.slovak: Naliehavo vás prosíme, aby ste neparkovali pred bránou.
naliehavo.english: We urgently ask you not to park in front of the gate.
The patient urgently needs an operation.

nadmieru.slovak: Nadmieru ma potešilo, že ste prišli.
nadmieru.english: I was exceedingly pleased that you came.
This year's results were exceedingly good.

nadmieru.slovak: S výsledkom sme boli nadmieru spokojní.
nadmieru.english: We were extremely pleased with the result.

ironicky.slovak: Ironicky poznamenal, že autobus prišiel výnimočne načas.
ironicky.english: He remarked ironically that the bus had come on time for once.

ironicky.slovak: Ironicky jej poďakoval za pomoc, ktorú nikdy nedostal.
ironicky.english: He ironically thanked her for help he never got.

ironicky.slovak: „To sa ti naozaj podarilo,“ povedala ironicky.
ironicky.english: “Well, you really pulled that off,” she said ironically.

ironicky.slovak: Ironicky sa usmial, keď počul tú výhovorku.
ironicky.english: He smiled ironically when he heard that excuse.

moralne.slovak: Priatelia ho v ťažkom období morálne podporili.
moralne.english: His friends supported him morally during a difficult time.

moralne.slovak: Je to síce legálne, ale morálne nesprávne.
moralne.english: It may be legal, but it's morally wrong.

moralne.slovak: Cítim sa morálne zodpovedný za to, čo sa stalo.
moralne.english: I feel morally responsible for what happened.

vystizne.slovak: Autor výstižne opísal život na dedine.
vystizne.english: The author aptly described life in the village.
She summed it up aptly in one sentence.

vystizne.slovak: Ten film veľmi výstižne zachytáva život v malom meste.
vystizne.english: The film captures life in a small town very aptly.
Grandpa always puts his finger on the problem.

mudro.slovak: Rozhodla si sa múdro, keď si ešte počkala.
mudro.english: You decided wisely when you waited a bit longer.

mudro.slovak: Starý otec vždy hovoril múdro a pokojne.
mudro.english: Grandfather always spoke wisely and calmly.

mudro.slovak: Urobil by si múdro, keby si sa ospravedlnil.
mudro.english: You would be wise to apologise.

netradicne.slovak: Svadbu oslávili netradične, na lúke pod horami.
netradicne.english: They celebrated their wedding unconventionally, in a meadow below the mountains.

netradicne.slovak: Kuchár pripravil halušky netradične, so špenátom.
netradicne.english: The chef made halušky in an unconventional way, with spinach.

netradicne.slovak: Tento rok sme Vianoce strávili netradične, na horách.
netradicne.english: This year we spent Christmas in an unusual way, in the mountains.

netradicne.slovak: Byt majú zariadený netradične, všade sú rastliny.
netradicne.english: Their flat is furnished unconventionally, with plants everywhere.

pokorne.slovak: Pokorne prijal kritiku a sľúbil zlepšenie.
pokorne.english: He humbly accepted the criticism and promised to improve.

pokorne.slovak: Za každú pomoc vždy pokorne ďakovala.
pokorne.english: She always humbly gave thanks for any help.
He humbly apologised for being late.
He bowed his head humbly and said nothing.

rapidne.slovak: Jeho zdravotný stav sa rapídne zhoršuje.
Mesto sa za posledné roky rapídne zmenilo.
rapidne.english: The town has changed rapidly in recent years.

rapidne.slovak: Počet turistov v meste rapídne stúpol.
rapidne.english: The number of tourists in the town rose rapidly.
In the evening it got cold very quickly.

bravurne.english: The pianist played the piece brilliantly.
The goalkeeper brilliantly saved the penalty.
The actress handled the demanding role brilliantly.

bravurne.slovak: Šoférka bravúrne zaparkovala v úzkej uličke.
bravurne.english: The driver parked brilliantly in the narrow lane.

rozpacito.slovak: Chvíľu rozpačito stál vo dverách a nevedel, čo povedať.
rozpacito.english: He stood hesitantly in the doorway for a moment, not knowing what to say.

rozpacito.slovak: Na pochvalu reagoval rozpačito, nebol na ňu zvyknutý.
rozpacito.english: He reacted awkwardly to the praise, he wasn't used to it.

rozpacito.slovak: Rozpačito sa usmiala a pozrela do zeme.
rozpacito.english: She smiled awkwardly and looked at the ground.

rozpacito.slovak: Na otázku odpovedal rozpačito a potichu.
rozpacito.english: He answered the question hesitantly and quietly.

poslusne.slovak: Pes si poslušne sadol k nohám pána.
poslusne.english: The dog obediently sat down at its owner's feet.
The children waited obediently on the pavement.
The boy obediently ate all his soup.

poslusne.slovak: Poslušne som vypol telefón, ako chcela učiteľka.
poslusne.english: I obediently switched off my phone, as the teacher wanted.

kruto.slovak: Život sa s nimi zahral kruto.
kruto.english: Life played a cruel trick on them.
The spring frosts cruelly damaged the harvest.

kruto.slovak: Za malú chybu ho kruto potrestali.
kruto.english: They punished him cruelly for a small mistake.

kruto.slovak: Starý sused zaobchádzal so psom kruto.
kruto.english: The old neighbour treated the dog cruelly.

elegantne.english: She was elegantly dressed for the concert.
He solved the problem elegantly and quickly.

elegantne.slovak: Tanečníci sa po parkete pohybovali elegantne.
elegantne.english: The dancers moved elegantly across the floor.
She elegantly avoided an awkward question.

agresivne.slovak: Vodič jazdil agresívne a predbiehal v zákrute.
agresivne.english: The driver drove aggressively and overtook on a bend.

agresivne.slovak: Pes reaguje na cudzích ľudí agresívne.
agresivne.english: The dog reacts aggressively to strangers.

agresivne.slovak: Firma agresívne bojuje o nových zákazníkov.
agresivne.english: The company is fighting aggressively for new customers.

agresivne.slovak: Nesprávaj sa k bratovi tak agresívne.
agresivne.english: Don't behave so aggressively towards your brother.

nasilne.slovak: Zlodeji sa do bytu dostali násilne.
nasilne.english: The thieves got into the flat by force.
Someone violently broke open the cellar door.

nasilne.slovak: Kľúč do zámky nestrkaj násilne, zlomíš ho.
nasilne.english: Don't force the key into the lock, you'll break it.
The police violently dispersed the protesters.

horlivo.slovak: Študenti horlivo diskutovali o novom zákone.
horlivo.english: The students eagerly discussed the new law.

horlivo.slovak: Horlivo si zapisovala každé slovo prednášky.
horlivo.english: She eagerly wrote down every word of the lecture.

horlivo.slovak: Deti horlivo pomáhali babke v záhrade.
horlivo.english: The children eagerly helped grandma in the garden.

horlivo.slovak: Horlivo prikyvoval všetkému, čo šéf povedal.
horlivo.english: He eagerly nodded at everything the boss said.

vrucne.slovak: Vrúcne ďakujeme všetkým, ktorí nám pomohli.
vrucne.english: We warmly thank everyone who helped us.

vrucne.slovak: Babka nás pri odchode vrúcne objala.
vrucne.english: Grandma hugged us warmly when we left.
We send you warm greetings from the Tatras.

vrucne.slovak: Vrúcne dúfam, že sa čoskoro uzdravíš.
vrucne.english: I sincerely hope you get well soon.

trpko.slovak: Trpko spomína na roky, keď nemal prácu.
trpko.english: He bitterly remembers the years when he had no job.

trpko.slovak: Trpko sa usmial a nič nepovedal.
trpko.english: He smiled bitterly and said nothing.
He paid bitterly for his mistake.

podrazdene.english: He answered the journalists' questions irritably.
The cat swished its tail irritably.

podrazdene.slovak: Po zlom spánku reaguje na všetko podráždene.
podrazdene.english: After a bad night's sleep he reacts irritably to everything.

vdacne.english: They gratefully accepted the neighbours' help.
I remember that trip with gratitude.

vdacne.slovak: Vďačne sa usmiala a vzala si kávu.
vdacne.english: She smiled gratefully and took the coffee.

hrozivo.english: The clouds over the mountains looked menacing.
The dog growled menacingly at the postman.
After the storm the river rose alarmingly.

hrozivo.slovak: Hrozivo zdvihol päsť, ale nakoniec odišiel.
hrozivo.english: He raised his fist menacingly, but in the end he left.

optimisticky.english: She looks to the future optimistically.

optimisticky.slovak: Lekár sa o liečbe vyjadril optimisticky.
optimisticky.english: The doctor spoke optimistically about the treatment.

optimisticky.slovak: Optimisticky sme rátali, že budeme doma do šiestej.
optimisticky.english: We optimistically reckoned we'd be home by six.

vyslovne.slovak: Výslovne som ťa prosil, aby si to nikomu nehovoril.
vyslovne.english: I expressly asked you not to tell anyone.

vyslovne.slovak: Na obale je výslovne uvedené, že výrobok nie je pre deti.
vyslovne.english: The packaging expressly states that the product is not for children.
The doctor expressly forbade me to smoke.

vyslovne.slovak: Výslovne povedala, že na oslavu nepríde.
vyslovne.english: She said explicitly that she wouldn't come to the party.

klasicky-adv.slovak: Na svadbu sa obliekol klasicky, do tmavého obleku.
klasicky-adv.english: He dressed classically for the wedding, in a dark suit.

klasicky-adv.slovak: Rezeň sa klasicky podáva so zemiakovým šalátom.
klasicky-adv.english: Schnitzel is classically served with potato salad.
As usual, I forgot my keys at home.

klasicky-adv.slovak: Vianočný stromček sme klasicky ozdobili červenými guľami.
klasicky-adv.english: We decorated the Christmas tree the classic way, with red baubles.

neisto.english: The child took its first steps uncertainly.

neisto.slovak: Neisto sa obzrela, či ide správnou cestou.
neisto.english: She looked around uncertainly, wondering if she was on the right path.

neisto.slovak: Na ľade stála neisto a držala sa zábradlia.
neisto.english: She stood unsteadily on the ice, holding on to the railing.

preventivne.slovak: Preventívne si v zime beriem vitamín C.
preventivne.english: In winter I take vitamin C as a preventive measure.

preventivne.slovak: Pred dlhou cestou dal auto preventívne skontrolovať.
preventivne.english: Before the long trip he had the car checked as a precaution.
The doctor prescribed him antibiotics as a precaution.
We took an umbrella just in case.

patricne.slovak: Na pracovný pohovor sa patrične obliekol.
patricne.english: He dressed appropriately for the job interview.

patricne.slovak: Bol to dôležitý hosť, a tak sme ho patrične privítali.
patricne.english: He was an important guest, so we welcomed him accordingly.

patricne.slovak: Za takú prácu ťa musia patrične zaplatiť.
patricne.english: They have to pay you properly for work like that.

racionalne.slovak: Snaž sa o tom uvažovať racionálne, nie v hneve.
racionalne.english: Try to think about it rationally, not in anger.

racionalne.slovak: Peniaze míňa racionálne a nič zbytočné nekupuje.
racionalne.english: She spends money rationally and buys nothing unnecessary.

racionalne.slovak: V strese sa ťažko rozhoduje racionálne.
racionalne.english: It's hard to make rational decisions under stress.

racionalne.slovak: Ak sa na to pozrieme racionálne, ten byt je pre nás pridrahý.
racionalne.english: If we look at it rationally, that flat is too expensive for us.

zjednodusene.english: Put simply, the company has no money.

zjednodusene.slovak: Učiteľ vysvetlil fotosyntézu zjednodušene, aby to deti pochopili.
zjednodusene.english: The teacher explained photosynthesis in a simplified way so the children would understand.
The map shows the town only in simplified form.

zjednodusene.slovak: Zjednodušene by sa dalo povedať, že sme sa rozišli pre peniaze.
zjednodusene.english: Simply put, we split up over money.

adekvatne.slovak: Na kritiku zareagoval adekvátne a pokojne.
adekvatne.english: He responded to the criticism adequately and calmly.
The hospital is not adequately equipped.
The company must pay its employees adequately.

adekvatne.slovak: Na takú otázku sa nedá adekvátne odpovedať za minútu.
adekvatne.english: You can't answer a question like that adequately in a minute.

zmatene.slovak: Zmätene sa obzeral po letiskovej hale.
zmatene.english: He looked around the airport hall in confusion.

zmatene.slovak: Hovoril zmätene a nedalo sa mu rozumieť.
zmatene.english: He spoke confusedly and it was impossible to understand him.

zmatene.slovak: Zmätene sa prehrabával v taške a hľadal lístok.
zmatene.english: He rummaged through his bag in confusion, looking for the ticket.

zmatene.slovak: Pozrela na mňa zmätene, akoby ma nepoznala.
zmatene.english: She looked at me in confusion, as if she didn't know me.

citelne.english: It got noticeably colder during the night.

citelne.slovak: Ceny potravín za rok citeľne stúpli.
citelne.english: Food prices rose noticeably over the year.

citelne.slovak: Po novom lieku sa mu citeľne uľavilo.
citelne.english: He felt noticeably better after the new medicine.

citelne.slovak: Keď sme vymenili okná, hluk z ulice citeľne zoslabol.
citelne.english: When we replaced the windows, the street noise dropped noticeably.

zarobkovo.slovak: Mnoho Slovákov odchádza zárobkovo do zahraničia.
zarobkovo.english: Many Slovaks go abroad to work.

zarobkovo.slovak: Popri škole pracuje zárobkovo ako čašník.

lenivo.english: He yawned lazily and rolled over onto his other side.

nevzdavat.slovak: Nevzdávaj nádej, všetko sa ešte môže zmeniť.

vzdavat.slovak: Mnohí študenti sa vzdávajú už v prvom ročníku.
